keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria lacks Jimma). The page gives no area and only one border ("shared its western border with Limmu-Ennarea"); the Gibe region is drawn as an 80 km disc round Jimma, as the ethiopian-empire dossier draws the Gibe states. Badi-Folla (1847) and Kullo (1889, with Abba Jifar's help) are named but not located.

ledger.note: 1737: the Kingdom of Jimma is established. Infobox "1737"; the text says only that it "emerged in the 18th century".

region.text: Jimma, the Gibe region round Jiren, which "shared its western border with Limmu-Ennarea"

ledger.note: 1830: Abba Jifar I converts to Islam and the kingdom is renamed Jimma Abba Jifar. "King Abba Jifar was also converted to Islam in 1830"; the infobox records the renaming; Abba Jifar I reigned 1830-1855.
1847: Jimma conquers Badi-Folla. The king "eventually conquered Badi-Folla (1847)". The page does not locate it and does not say whose it was.

region.text: Badi-Folla, conquered in 1847 (its location is not on the page; a 110 km disc round Jimma stands in)

ledger.note: May 1932: Jimma is annexed. "on 5 May 1932" the newspaper Berhanena Selam editorialised about the kingdom's danger and "seven days later, soldiers and administrators brought the kingdom to an end".

sources.title: Kingdom of Jimma
sources.note: Infobox 1737-1932; capital Jiren; Abba Jifar I converted 1830 and reigned 1830-1855; Badi-Folla 1847; vassal of Shewa 1884 and of Ethiopia 1889; annexed May 1932.

notes: New dossier: Cliopatria lacks Jimma. One page opened (Kingdom of Jimma; budget 1-2). Disagreement with the ethiopian-empire dossier (af-01-b), which has Jimma, Limmu, Gera and Guma tributary from 1881: this page's infobox lists Jimma as a vassal of the Kingdom of Shewa in 1884 and of the Ethiopian Empire in 1889, and dates the conquest of Kullo to 1889 'with Abba Jifar's help' (Jimma is also a belligerent in the Kaffa dossier). The vassal tint belongs in the Ethiopian dossier (the lord's side); this dossier keeps Jimma sovereign until the 1932 annexation. Not on the page: Abba Jifar II's submission year, the area, other Gibe kingdoms (Limmu-Ennarea, Gera, Guma, Gomma). Gazetteer: all names resolved; the capital coordinate is approximate.
